title: Plugin list deadline does not bound process exit: a grandchild holding the pipes keeps quest alive past it
description: From lore-cli via opum-agent OPAG-448 AC3 (2)(a). lore-cli found its port of our adapter carried this and fixed it in opum-ai/lore-cli#291, merged dev dc09ca98 (pre-squash fix 277aeb31), src/adapters/agent-plugins.ts bunPluginCommandRunner: spawn the runtime detached, on the deadline process.kill(-pid, SIGKILL) and cancel() both stdout/stderr readers; on win32 child.kill plus the cancel. Only the group kill reaps the grandchild; the cancel alone gets exit to about 1s and leaves it alive. MEASURED HERE 2026-09-26 at origin/dev f21783a: a fake codex running `trap "" TERM; sleep 12 & sleep 12`, CliAgentPluginPort listTimeoutMs 2000. The report settled at 2.002s ("did not finish within 2s") and the process exited at 12.067s, when the grandchild ended. src/adapters/agents/cli-agent-plugins.ts run() does child.kill(SIGKILL) plus unref(), which releases the child handle but not the pending Response(child.stdout).text() reads. The same run() serves the 600s update path.

acceptanceCriteria.text: On the deadline, run() kills the runtime process group (POSIX, spawned detached) and cancels both pipe readers; on win32 it kills the child and cancels the readers

A test using a fake runtime whose backgrounded grandchild holds the pipes times the REAL quest process exit and asserts it is bounded by the deadline plus a small margin, and that the grandchild is gone
The fix is cited against lore-cli dc09ca98 / 277aeb31, and bun run check exits 0
